title: Using CANVAS background on 3D camera does not work.
body:
### Tested versions

Found in v4.5.stable, v4.5.stable.mono

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable.mono unknown - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 02 Oct 2025 19:26:36 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT (RADV NAVI31) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700K (20 threads) - 31.10 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using the environment property in the camera and setting the background to canvas does not work. The canvas layer was added correctly and the "Layer" value was set below the "background_canvas_max_layer" of the environment. Yet the canvas was rendered above the actual camera.

Moving the environment to a WorldEnvironment node makes the background environment work correctly.

### Steps to reproduce

The steps expects already a 3D scene with some 3D objects, that are rendered.

1. Add a CanvasLayer to the scene, fill it with content (be it a image or text) and set the layer to -1
2. Add a Envionment to the scenes camera.
3. In the Envionment, change the background to Canvas and make sure the Canvas Max Layer remains at 0.
4. Start the scene.

The bug appears when the Canvas gets rendered above the 3D objects.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[background-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22785024/background-bug.zip)
